name: CrunchDAO Obesity ML Challenge – Part 1
organizer: CrunchDAO & Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center at the Broad Institute
description: Predicted single-cell transcriptomic responses to CRISPR single-gene perturbations in human fat-cell precursors. Built a model to forecast gene expression profiles and cell-state proportions for 2,863 unseen gene knockouts, competing against 1,000+ data scientists worldwide.
